title: A month day's "N failed" counts its missed slots as failed
body:
## Summary
MonthCalendar's day head and accessible name say 'N failed' for isBad, which is failed OR missed.

## Description
MonthCalendar.tsx:147 `fails = list.filter(isBad).length`, drawn as `{fails} failed` (:163) and spoken `, N failed` (:157). The rail and the agenda name the same set 'Failed · missed · drift' (CalendarColumn.tsx:289, MonthCalendar.tsx agenda head). A missed slot is not a failure: no platform sentence, it moves from the next full hour (slot.ts moveDefault). The cell is ~120 px wide at 1920, so the fix is a word choice under a width the round could not photograph.

## Flow
- month with a missed slot on Oct 2 -> the cell says '1 failed'
- build: count failed and missed apart (e.g. '1 missed'), or one word for both; cx-capture floor-month at 1920 and 390

## Expected impact
The operator reads a missed window as a platform failure. Could break: the cell head's fit at narrow widths.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the cell names the state it counts
Before: a missed slot counted under 'failed' (1 of 1 missed slots misnamed)
After: predicted 0 misnamed
Method: simulation - the wording's fit needs a photographed cell (no dev server in a round)
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: a floor-slot markup case (a missed-only day must not say 'failed') seeded red on HEAD, plus CX_BASE=... node pipeline/cx-capture.mjs floor-month out.png --width 1920 and --width 390 to see the head fits

title: ChannelReadiness writes the calendar's UTC instant a third time, without UTC
body:
## Summary
ChannelReadiness.tsx `when` is `${dayLabel(dayKey(t))} ${clock(t)}` - the shape calendar.ts whenUtc now owns, minus ' · UTC'.

## Description
packages/ui/src/components/floor/ChannelReadiness.tsx:25-28. Every other instant on the calendar says UTC (CLAUDE.md-era rule in calendar.ts header: 'the clock the page names is the one it computes with'); the readiness rows' last-out and last-failure hours do not. Out of this round's paths (floor-lanes-runs owns the file).

## Flow
- open the month agenda -> channels -> 'Wed 14 Oct 09:00' with no zone
- build: read whenUtc from ./calendar.ts

## Expected impact
The readiness hour reads as local when it is UTC. Could break: the readiness test's literal hours.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one spelling of a calendar instant
Before: 2 spellings (whenUtc, ChannelReadiness when)
After: predicted 1
Method: simulation - out-of-scope file
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: floor-schedule.test.ts readiness case asserting 'UTC' beside lastOut/lastFailure hours, red on HEAD; out-of-scope (floor-lanes-runs)

title: The month bar's channel toggles count all time beside tallies that count the month
body:
## Summary
Each channel toggle draws every slot ever on that channel; the state tallies beside it count only the page's month.

## Description
MonthCalendar.tsx:106 `slots.filter((x) => x.channel === c).length` (all slots, all months, ignoring toggles) vs :114-123 tallies over `inMonth`. Two counts in one bar with different scopes and no word for either. Which the toggle should state (the month's, or the channel's whole calendar since the toggle hides it on every page) is the owner's call.

## Flow
- a year of slots -> youtube toggle says 300 while the month's tallies sum to 25

## Expected impact
A reader adds the bar's numbers and they do not reconcile. Could break: nothing structural.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the bar's numbers share one scope
Before: 2 scopes in one bar
After: 1 scope (either choice)
Method: simulation - the choice of scope is a direction, not a measurement
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction

title: The move field stays editable while a verb is in flight
body:
## Summary
SlotDetail's move input is not disabled while busy, unlike every ScheduleForm control.

## Description
SlotDetail.tsx move form input has no disabled={!idle}; its Move submit and every verb are disabled while busy, so no second act can be sent. ScheduleForm disables its inputs too (submit-lifecycle).

## Flow
- press Move, type in the field before it answers -> the field takes the text; nothing is sent

## Expected impact
None: the field is spent on landing (the stamp resets it).

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - second act while busy
Before: 0 double sends possible (submit and verbs disabled)
After: 0
Method: probe - read the three disabled guards
Result: not-better
Gate: none
